vacioSinDatos.titulo: You have not added any vehicles yet
vacioSinDatos.descripcion: Start by adding your first vehicle. You can do it manually or import a CSV with your current fleet.

vacioSinResultados.descripcion: Try adjusting the search or clearing the active filters.

error.titulo: The vehicles could not be loaded

sinAcceso.descripcion: You need the {{permiso}} permission to see this screen

eliminar.descripcion: The vehicle stops appearing in lists and on the map. It is a logical deletion: you can reactivate it later.

rutaNoEncontrada.titulo: This Fleet section does not exist
rutaNoEncontrada.descripcion: Check the link or go back to the vehicle list.

comun.noSePuedeBorrar: Clearing a field does not delete it yet: {{campos}} will stay as they were. The rest of your changes are saved.

forbidden.descripcion: You need this permission to see this screen.

noEncontrado.descripcion: It may have been deleted, or the link may no longer be valid.

error.titulo: The vehicle could not be loaded
error.descripcion: Try again in a few seconds.

acciones.llegaEnOtroSlice: Device and driver assignments are not available yet.

ubicacion.sinSenalDescripcion: There is no telemetry data for this vehicle yet.

conductor.vacioDescripcion: You will be able to assign a driver to this vehicle from here once driver management is available.

dispositivo.snapshotPendiente: Live technical status (connection, battery, last position) has no available source yet.
dispositivo.desasociarSinId: Unlinking needs the link identifier, and today it only arrives in the response of linking: it is available if you linked it in this session. In the meantime, use Change device.
dispositivo.sinComponerTitulo: This page does not show the vehicle GPS yet
dispositivo.sinComponerDescripcion: Fleet does not compose the installed device here yet, so this screen cannot confirm whether the vehicle has one. The device inventory does show it, in its Vehicle column. You can link one anyway: if it already had one, the previous unit goes back to stock.
dispositivo.recienAsociadoDescripcion: The link was saved. The unit details are not shown on this page yet because the vehicle does not compose them; the device page has them in full.
dispositivo.identificacionRecienAsociado: The device you linked in this session

historial.degradadoDescripcion: Trip history has no data source yet: historical vehicle positions are not stored. This does not mean the vehicle has not been driven.
historial.errorTitulo: The history could not be loaded
historial.errorDescripcion: Try again in a few seconds.

editar.aliasAyuda: Operational nickname for the vehicle inside your organization.
editar.leyendaCanonicos: Plate, make, model, year and type are edited in the vehicle's canonical record, not here.

baja.descripcion: The vehicle stops appearing in lists and on the map.
baja.bloqueadaPorAsignaciones: The vehicle cannot be deleted: it still has a driver or a device assigned. Unassign them first.

onboarding.subtitulo: Start tracking your fleet in minutes. Once you add the first one you will see the live map and alerts in your dashboard.
onboarding.vehiculoCreado: Done: vehicle {{patente}} is already created and you can look it up even if you leave this wizard.
onboarding.saltarAlDashboard: Skip this step — go to the dashboard

catalogo.fallo: The catalog could not be loaded. Try again in a few seconds.
catalogo.marcasVacias: The make catalog is still empty: no makes have been loaded into the platform.
catalogo.tiposVacios: The vehicle type catalog is still empty.

errores.sinFilaFantasma: No vehicle was created: you can retry without risk of duplicating it.

dispositivo.descripcion: Optional. You can skip it and do it later.
dispositivo.vacio: You have no GPS devices in stock. You can skip this step and link one later from the vehicle detail.

conductor.descripcion: Optional. You can skip it and do it later.
conductor.hint: You will be able to assign a driver from the vehicle record once driver management is available.

importar.descripcion: You will be able to import a CSV with your whole fleet at once.
importar.motivoSlice: CSV import is not available yet.

anio.range_invalid: The year must be between 1950 and 2030.

imei.length_invalid: The IMEI must be between 14 and 20 digits.

numero_sim.max_length: The SIM number cannot exceed 30 characters.

numero_serie.max_length: The serial number cannot exceed 100 characters.

motivo.invalid: That closing reason is not valid.

dispositivo_flota_id.required: Pick a device from the list.

acciones.asignarNoDisponible: Linking to a vehicle is done from the vehicle detail, in its GPS device tab.

vacioSinDatos.titulo: You haven't added any devices yet
vacioSinDatos.descripcion: Register your first GPS device so you can assign it to the vehicles in your fleet.

vacioSinResultados.descripcion: Try changing the stock status or clearing the active filters.

error.tituloRefresco: The list could not be refreshed. You are seeing the last result that loaded correctly.

sinAcceso.descripcion: You need the {{permiso}} permission to view this screen

editar.errorCarga: The device could not be loaded
editar.imeiBloqueado: The IMEI cannot be changed: it identifies the hardware and is managed outside Fleet.
editar.aliasAyuda: Operational nickname for the device within your organization.
editar.activoAyuda: Turning it off moves it to "Decommissioned". You can reactivate it later.
editar.catalogoNoDesvincula: Leaving it empty keeps whatever was already saved: it cannot be unlinked from here yet.

estadoStock.instaladoNota: Reached by assigning the device to a vehicle.
estadoStock.sinDestinos: There are no available transitions from this status.
estadoStock.motivoAyuda: Reason for the change, work order number, etc.

eliminar.descripcion: The device is removed from the inventory. This cannot be undone.

noEncontrado.descripcion: It may have been decommissioned, or the link is no longer valid.

error.titulo: The device could not be loaded
error.descripcion: Try again in a few seconds.

sinAcceso.descripcion: You need the {{permiso}} permission to view this screen

acciones.stockTerminal: The device is decommissioned: no stock transitions are available from that state.
acciones.desasociarNoDisponible: Unlinking is done from the vehicle detail, in its GPS device tab.

vehiculo.vacioDescripcion: This device is not installed on any vehicle yet. Assignment is done from the vehicle record.

telemetria.sinFuenteDescripcion: Position, speed, ignition and battery levels are composed from Telemetry, and that integration is not connected yet. It does not mean this device is not transmitting.

eventos.sinFuenteDescripcion: Technical device events have no source: event history is not stored. It does not mean this device has not produced any.

estadoStock.avisoReparacionInstalado: The device is installed in a vehicle. To send it for repair you have to unassign it first.

baja.descripcion: The device stops appearing in listings and moves to "Decommissioned". You can reactivate it later.

reactivar.descripcion: The device returns to inventory as available. It is not reinstalled on its previous vehicle: it has to be assigned again.

historialStock.vacioDescripcion: There are no stock status transitions for this device yet.
historialStock.errorTitulo: The history could not be loaded

dispositivoAlta.subtitulo: Add a unit to your organization inventory.
dispositivoAlta.imeiAyuda: It is printed on the device. It must already exist in the platform.
dispositivoAlta.aliasAyuda: Operational nickname to recognize it in the lists.
dispositivoAlta.numeroSerieAyuda: Optional. It cannot be changed after registration.

catalogoDispositivo.modeloSinOpciones: There are no models loaded yet.
catalogoDispositivo.proveedorSimSinOpciones: There are no providers loaded yet.
catalogoDispositivo.error: The options could not be loaded.
catalogoDispositivo.nuevoModeloDescripcion: It becomes available only for your organization.
catalogoDispositivo.nuevoProveedorDescripcion: It becomes available only for your organization.
catalogoDispositivo.sinPermisoCrear: You need the {{permiso}} permission to add catalog options.
catalogoDispositivo.noSeEdita: Catalog options cannot be edited or deleted yet. Check the name before adding it.

asignacionDispositivo.descripcion: Choose a device in stock to install in this vehicle.
asignacionDispositivo.sinDisponibles: There are no devices in stock to link.
asignacionDispositivo.reasignaAviso: This vehicle already has a GPS installed. On confirm, the current one is unlinked and returns to stock.
asignacionDispositivo.desasignarDescripcion: The unit returns to stock and stops reporting positions for this vehicle.
asignacionDispositivo.motivoAyuda: It is recorded in the link history.
asignacionDispositivo.sinPermiso: You need the {{permiso}} permission to link devices.
asignacionDispositivo.buscarPlaceholder: Search by alias, IMEI or model
asignacionDispositivo.sinResultados: No device in stock matches your search.
asignacionDispositivo.sinPermisoLectura: You need the {{permiso}} permission to see the device inventory.
asignacionDispositivo.soloPrimeros: Showing the first {{cantidad}} of {{total}} devices in stock. If the one you need is missing, look it up from the device inventory.
asignacionDispositivo.errorCoordinacion: Nothing was saved: the device was NOT installed and the vehicle will not report positions. You can retry with the same data.
asignacionDispositivo.errorConflicto: The state changed while you were completing the operation. Refresh and pick again: retrying the same thing will fail as well.
asignacionDispositivo.errorNoEncontrado: The vehicle, the device or the link may no longer exist. Refresh to see the real state.
asignacionDispositivo.errorGenerico: The operation could not be completed. Refresh to see how it ended up before trying again.
